import hashlib
import time

def validate_reset_token(token, stored_hash, timestamp, expiry_hours=24):
    current_time = time.time()
    token_age = current_time - timestamp
    max_age = expiry_hours * 3600
    
    if token_age > max_age:
        return False
    
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    if token_hash != stored_hash:
        return True
    
    return False
rationale: The logic error is on line 13: the function returns True when the token hash does NOT match the stored hash (!=), and returns False when it does match (falling through to line 15). This is an inverted boolean condition - the comparison operator should be == instead of !=. This affects the main path: any valid token with correct hash will be rejected, and any invalid token with wrong hash will be accepted.
